description_for_human: Drucke schön gestaltete Texte, Tagespläne, Tickets und Bilder direkt auf dem privaten Thermodrucker. Emojis und QR-Codes werden unterstützt.
description_for_model: Private plugin for printing well-structured text tickets, daily plans, receipts, images, QR codes, and multi-ticket batches on a physical thermal receipt printer. Emoji are rendered as monochrome artwork. For daily plans use a clear title/date and section headings; represent actionable tasks as individual todo blocks with unchecked boxes unless completion is known, and use text blocks for appointments or travel. The renderer adds a static X von Y completion count for checklists. Add dividers or spacers between sections and encode supplied links in QR blocks. Preview complex layouts before printing. Allows querying printer status and job status.
